entries.name: Port Moresby
entries.coordinates_source: WV Papua New Guinea cities list
entries.note: City: the national capital and main gateway to PNG, a destination in its own right with the city's spots around it.
entries.reason: Kept; base passes the name test (see destinations-proposed.json name_evidence) and has the spots to fill a visit.

entries.name: Port Moresby Nature Park
entries.note: Wildlife and botanical park (formerly the National Capital Botanical Gardens) with tree kangaroos, cassowaries, birds of paradise, a WWII walk-through aviary and gardens.
entries.reason: Kept; inside the span of Port Moresby and reached from that base.

entries.name: National Museum and Art Gallery
entries.wiki: Papua New Guinea National Museum and Art Gallery
entries.note: Museum: PNG's national museum in Waigani, with carvings, beads, traditional boats, cultural objects and WWII relics outside.
entries.reason: Kept; inside the span of Port Moresby and reached from that base.

entries.name: Ela Beach
entries.coordinates_source: WV Port Moresby listing geo (Ela Beach Craft Market point on the beach; no OSM "Ela Beach" feature found, check)
entries.note: Beach: the revitalised waterfront in central Port Moresby, a paved promenade for walks and sunsets, with weekend markets and cultural events (not a swimming beach).
entries.reason: Kept; inside the span of Port Moresby and reached from that base.

entries.name: Bomana War Cemetery
entries.note: War cemetery: the largest WWII Commonwealth cemetery in PNG, 3,824 graves, mostly from the Kokoda campaign; free and open daily, 19 km out of town.
entries.reason: Kept; inside the span of Port Moresby and reached from that base.

entries.name: National Parliament of Papua New Guinea
entries.wiki: National Parliament of Papua New Guinea
entries.note: Landmark: the parliament building in Waigani, designed on a Maprik haus tambaran; visitors see the exterior, with guided tours outside sitting days.
entries.reason: Kept; inside the span of Port Moresby and reached from that base.

entries.name: Gordons Market
entries.coordinates_source: photon OSM amenity=marketplace "Gordons Market" (resolver LOW, hand-graded; verify)
entries.note: Market: a daily city market in Gordons with produce, betel nut, crafts and bilums; best visited in the morning with a guide.
entries.reason: Kept; inside the span of Port Moresby and reached from that base.

entries.name: Loloata Island
entries.coordinates_source: photon OSM leisure=resort "Loloata Island Resort" (the visitor point on the island; resolver LOW, verify)
entries.note: Island: a private island resort in Bootless Inlet, 20-30 minutes by boat from Port Moresby, with snorkelling, diving, kayaks and day visits.
entries.reason: Kept; inside the span of Port Moresby and reached from that base.

entries.name: Adventure Park PNG
entries.pin_needed: coordinates null: needs resolve-pin.py or the owner (not guessed)
entries.note: Family amusement park at 14 Mile, outside the city, with a Ferris wheel, water slides, paddle boats, a small zoo, lakes and gardens.
entries.reason: Kept; inside the span of Port Moresby and reached from that base.
entries.within_span: unverified (no coordinates): described as nearby in source

entries.name: Varirata National Park
entries.pin_needed: coordinates null: needs resolve-pin.py or the owner (not guessed)
entries.note: National park: PNG's first national park, 23 km NE of Port Moresby on the Sogeri Plateau, with lookouts, a lake, trails, birdwatching and picnic areas; admission charged.
entries.reason: National park but no other kept spot in it (Sogeri Plateau only shares the area): under COVERAGE a national park with fewer than four spots is a standalone spot, not a destination.

entries.name: Sogeri Plateau
entries.pin_needed: coordinates null: needs resolve-pin.py or the owner (not guessed)
entries.note: Natural area: 600 m plateau 'a popular weekend trip' from Port Moresby, with picnic sites, rapids and walks (Wikipedia article is the town of Sogeri on the plateau).
entries.reason: Cluster Sogeri Plateau, Varirata National Park (and Owers' Corner, which belongs to the Kokoda Track) is below four spots; the plateau is not a name with its own visitor chapter. Pin needed (Wikipedia article is the town of Sogeri).

entries.name: Kerema
entries.note: Town: the capital of Gulf Province on the Gulf of Papua coast, a basic base for the Gulf with a few hotels, reached by the Hiritano Highway or by air.
entries.reason: Gulf Province town: Kerema and Kikori are 2: standalone.

entries.name: Kikori
entries.note: Town: a small fishing centre on the Kikori River delta, a good birdwatching base with Delta Lodge.

entries.name: Owers' Corner
entries.reason: Same place kept in region-png-oro-kokoda; one entry only, placed there.

entries.name: Kokoda Track
entries.reason: Same place kept in region-png-oro-kokoda; one entry only, placed there.

reviews.name: Iarokrai Rapids
reviews.reason: One counted source (tourism board story): family-run campsite and rapids with a 2 hr trek to a stone-markings site; a half-day-plus visit but booking by phone, closed Saturdays.
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: board names it as a 'best kept secret' with a swim and trek. Against: one source, small private operator, near-duplicate of Crystal Rapids/Sogeri area.

reviews.name: Moitaka Wildlife Sanctuary
reviews.reason: One counted source (Wikivoyage See): crocodiles and birds on the Sir Hubert Murray Highway; access, hours and condition unverified.
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: a wildlife stop with a guide listing. Against: one thin line, no hours or site, possibly run down.

reviews.name: Atama Beach
reviews.reason: One counted source (Wikivoyage Do, free, open 24h) at Pari on Taurama Road; a beach with a hiking route is second-tier, but the listing is a single line.
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: an open-access beach near Loloata. Against: single source, local use, safety concerns.

reviews.name: Boroko Market
reviews.reason: One counted source (same board article) names it alongside Gordons Market as a daily market; a near-duplicate of Gordons in type.
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: daily market, board-named. Against: single mention, safety, near-duplicate.

reviews.name: Hanuabada
reviews.reason: One counted source (Wikivoyage lists Hiri villages); a large stilt-house Motu village on the harbour, strong Wikipedia interest (6,288 views); visiting is cultural but needs a guide and has safety issues.
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: the city's best-known cultural village. Against: a living community, no visitor facilities, one source.

reviews.name: Lakekamu Basin
reviews.reason: One counted source (Wikivoyage Western PNG): remote 2,500 sq km rainforest in Gulf for birding, reached only by charter or specialist tour with basic guest houses.
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: a significant wilderness named by a guide. Against: very remote, operator-only, one source.

reviews.name: Bulldog Track
reviews.reason: One counted source (tourism board Gulf page, calls it a must-see): a 60 km trek from the Lakekamu side to Wau; an expedition, and half lies in Morobe.
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: a named multi-day trek, 1,226 views. Against: one source, specialist, ends outside the region.

note: PNG has no existing destinations or spots. Placement run jointly for all nine regions; proposed destinations are in curation/png/destinations-proposed.json.
